items.description: Each entry is one argv element, NOT a shell program: command substitution ($(...), backticks) and process substitution (<(...), >(...)) are REJECTED, by this schema and by the runner at load. A manifest carrying a shell program cannot be checked, tested, or reviewed -- every character is escaped twice and no linter can see it. Put the logic in a .sh file next to the manifest, COPY it into the image, and call that (e.g. ["sh", "run.sh"], or use the script field). Plain $VAR / ${VAR} references are fine.

context.description: The status context string (e.g. "ci/deploy"). Required when enabled is true.

target_url.description: Optional URL linked from the GitHub status check.

file.description: Script file path, relative to the hook or manager directory. Must resolve inside that directory -- a symlink escaping it is a load error.

interpreter.description: Interpreter that runs the file. Must be installed in the image (the Dockerfile bakes the code in; nothing is mounted).

args.description: Additional arguments passed after the script path.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for {"eq": ...}: the path/header must stringify to exactly this value.

eq.description: Matches a leaf whose stringified value equals this exactly.

ne.description: Matches a leaf whose stringified value differs. A missing path does NOT match (absence is not inequality).

in.description: Matches a leaf whose stringified value equals any listed value.

exists.description: true matches when the path resolves to anything (header present); false when it does not.

prefix.description: Matches a leaf whose stringified value starts with this.

regex.description: Matches a leaf containing a match of this Go (RE2 — linear-time, no backtracking) pattern; anchor with ^ and $ for a full match. Compiled at load time — a non-compiling pattern fails validation.

oneOf.description: Operator object; when several operators are set, all must accept (AND).
